issues.problem: Frame <giver>は<superior>に…を___ let the distractor いただきました form a natural sentence (X received Z from the superior, with に as source), so only the English ruled it out.
issues.action: Changed the giver marker to から (<giver>から<superior>に…さしあげました), which makes いただきました, くださいました and くれました all ungrammatical; updated why.

issues.problem: Value 手帳 'planner' is implausible with 十年前/昔 + 今も使っています (planners are yearly); English 'take good care of' did not render 大切に使っています.
issues.action: Replaced 手帳 with 名刺入れ 'business card holder'; English changed to 'I am still carefully using the <thing> I received from <superior> <when>.'
